title: Eat Shit And Die 131
author: bpatrick
body: Welcome to the new site! We have Emulsifier to thank for this awesomeness. He kicks ass. We now have a “comments” feature which I welcome (implore) you to use. There may be a few wrinkles to iron out yet but enjoy! Today’s comic shows a softer side of the usually tough-as-nails Shannon.

comments.author: emulsifier
comments.text: Hey guys, we are now using comicpress to power the site instead of the stuff I wrote. The old site is still available (for now) at akimbocomics.com. I am also working on figuring out how to configure apache to still have the old comic links available so that bookmarks etc. don’t go away. Please subscribe to the RSS feed with the link above, more changes will be on the way.

comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.text: Wicked, man! Finally a comments feature, plus the comic ain’t bad neither.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: Thanks, Winston! I’m excited about the comments feature – you have the honors of being the first!

comments.text: Finally, dude! Congrats on the comment feature.
